included: All 50 active entries in docs/.vuepress/reader/diagrams/*.json: title/titleTw, question/questionTw, answer/answerTw, summary/summaryTw, alt/altTw.
All 100 active SC desktop/mobile SVGs and their 100 generated *-tw.svg counterparts, including accessible title/desc and visible text.
Existing conversion conventions in bin/zh-tw.py, bin/tw-terms.tsv and review/reader/localize.py; pinned OpenCC version and existing localization tests.
excluded: Independent correctness of the SC diagram concepts, invented examples, source-book interpretation, Python adaptations or teaching claims.
Reader learning, comprehension, usability or performance validation.
Screenshots, rendered text bounds, geometry layout quality, themes, builds and final integration.
The separately reviewed old docs/zh-tw full-book body, original-figure reproductions, retired diagrams and archived drafts.
scope.edits: Only this report. No source, generated SVG, manifest, converter, test or body-Markdown edits.
scope.reviewStandard: Technical informational text: preserve meaning, qualifications and established terminology. Do not redesign the conversion pipeline or flag merely preferred regional wording.

summary.qualificationReview: No additional conversion-induced omission of conditions, negation, uncertainty, invented-example attribution or non-guarantees was found in the reviewed pairs. This does not validate those SC claims.
summary.knownCh19PassThroughIssue: The supplied narrow fix is present and effective in the reviewed ch19 assets. It is not reported as unresolved. R6 concerns a different remaining condition-pass context in ch13; R5 concerns evidential support, not pass/through.

method.extraction: Parsed every metadata file with Python json and every paired SVG with xml.etree.ElementTree. Matched SVG nodes by ordered, namespace-aware tree structure, then compared attributes and text/tail slots. No regex extraction of JSON or XML.
method.semanticReview: Read all 294 metadata pairs, then all distinct SVG pairs not already represented by metadata. Identical SC/TW pairs were deduplicated only for reading; every occurrence remained in the structural comparison and coverage inventory. All changed distinct pairs were read with SC and TW together; unchanged strings were also inspected.
method.deduplication: Exact ordered (SC text, TW text) equality only; not similarity, machine back-translation or vocabulary sampling.
method.conversionCheck: Compared every localized string and serialized SVG with the current OpenCC 1.4.1 s2twp.json plus ordered tw-terms.tsv pipeline. Deterministic agreement was treated as provenance, not semantic approval.
method.locationNotation: JSON locations are zero-based JSON Pointers to generated fields; remove the terminal Tw suffix for the SC field. XML locations use one-based sibling indices by local tag name in the SVG namespace. text() means ElementTree element.text, not descendant-concatenated text. Remove the final -tw from the SVG filename for its SC source.
method.evidenceStrings: sourceExact and generatedExact are literal extracted strings or exact contiguous fragments, not back-translations. Each location must contain its corresponding fragment.
method.suggestedRules: All listed literal rules are proposals only, expressed against the current final TW output. If adopted as TSV rules, place them in the existing late, context-specific correction section, after the broad rules that create these outputs. Source-wording alternatives are alternatives, not cumulative mandatory edits. Do not patch generated files.
method.externalTerminologyCheck: Consulted primary technical documentation only to distinguish an invariant condition from an unchanging value and string concatenation from a connection. This did not validate any SC diagram or implementation.

findings.title: The library rule corrupts repository and inventory nouns
findings.why: The ch17 repository is not a function library, and the ch19 inventory export is not a library-inventory export. The inserted 函式 changes the subjects of these examples and creates malformed nouns. This is not a choice between acceptable regional synonyms.
findings.cause: OpenCC emits 倉庫 and 庫存 correctly. bin/tw-terms.tsv:161, re (?<![碼料存產類])庫 -> 函式庫, subsequently matches both. The rule's exclusions do not cover 倉 or the inventory compound.

evidence.suggestedTw: 儲存庫
庫存
evidence.countNote: The mobile desc contains two occurrences of 库存; 11 affected inventory text pairs contain 12 malformed inventory nouns.

suggestedNarrowRules.pattern: 函式庫存: if comma(f): quote(f)

findings.sourceWordingAlternative: For the repository case only, 代码库 is an unambiguous SC alternative already protected by the existing 程式碼庫 convention. Inventory must retain its inventory meaning.
regressionChecks: Check every listed location, including both 库存 occurrences in the mobile desc.
Keep 标准库 logging -> 標準函式庫 logging and existing 程式碼庫/資料庫/儲存庫 intact.
Do not use an unrestricted 函式庫存 -> 庫存 replacement: it could damage a legitimate phrase about a library storing something.

findings.title: A storage flush becomes a UI-style refresh
findings.why: The source discusses writing cached data out and the separate guarantees on which a database can rely. 重新整理 selects the refresh sense instead. The existing convention explicitly identifies this flush/refresh ambiguity, but its full-book phrase does not match this new reader answer.
findings.cause: OpenCC s2twp.json produces 相關重新整理與持久化保證. The existing narrow rule for 將資料重新整理到輔助儲存 does not apply.

evidence.sourceExact: 数据库须知道相关刷新与持久化保证，才能判断何时可依赖崩溃后仍保存的数据。
evidence.generatedExact: 資料庫須知道相關重新整理與持久化保證，才能判斷何時可依賴崩潰後仍儲存的資料。
evidence.suggestedTw: 資料庫須知道相關資料寫出（flush）與持久化保證，才能判斷何時可依賴崩潰後仍儲存的資料。

suggestedNarrowRules.pattern: 相關重新整理與持久化保證
suggestedNarrowRules.replacement: 相關資料寫出（flush）與持久化保證

findings.sourceWordingAlternative: Replace only 相关刷新与持久化保证 with 相关数据写出（flush）与持久化保证 in the SC reader answer.
regressionChecks: Keep the later 只有...時...才可隱藏 condition intact.
Do not imply that every flush API guarantees durability, and do not globally replace 重新整理.

findings.title: The invariant term is split into an apparent unchanging variable
findings.why: Here 不变量 names a condition relating C to buffer state, not a value that stays unchanged. The same source explicitly updates C from 8 to 5. 不變數 is a misleading split of that technical term in this context; 不變條件 preserves the relational meaning without suggesting that C is constant.
findings.cause: OpenCC converts 不变量 to 不變數; the current postprocessing has no whole-term exception.

findings.title: Returning to a workflow step becomes returning a data value
findings.why: These six uses of 返回 describe revisiting a step or routing back to an encoder. 回傳 instead suggests sending back a task, an interface description, a check, or an encoder as a result. The ch19 desc is especially misleading because the source routes input to the same encoder; it does not return an encoder object.
findings.cause: bin/tw-terms.tsv:226 applies the unconditional 返回 -> 回傳 rule to non-function-return prose.

evidence.suggestedTw: 右側迴路回到趕任務

evidence.sourceExact: 通过回箭头返回接口说明
evidence.generatedExact: 透過回箭頭回傳介面說明

findings.sourceWordingAlternative: Prefer 回到 for these workflow uses only. For the awkward ch15 source clause, 问题可促使重新检查接口说明 makes the intended feedback step explicit without a broad conversion exception.
regressionChecks: Retain actual result-return terminology, including 返回 C, 返回 None, 返回值 and 返回对象.
Do not change main 回傳 solely as a stylistic preference; this finding is confined to the six non-function-return contexts.

findings.title: Evidence supporting a conclusion becomes feature support
findings.why: The source describes evidence for a judgment, not providing operational support for a capability. 支援介面簡單的判斷 and 支援覆蓋這一條迴歸 select the wrong support sense. This weakens the distinction between observations supporting coverage and a system supporting test coverage; the explicit non-proof qualifications must remain.
findings.cause: OpenCC maps 支持 to 支援 without separating evidential support from feature support.

findings.title: A separate ch13 condition-pass context still becomes through
findings.why: 前三项通过 means that the first three conditions passed or were satisfied. 前三項透過 loses that predicate and reads as an incomplete through construction. The separate maxPos gate and the non-success qualification are present, but this concluding distinction is mistranslated.
findings.cause: bin/tw-terms.tsv:191 changes 通過 to 透過 here. The new ch19-specific exceptions do not and should not incidentally match this different phrase.

findings.title: Joining output fields becomes connecting fields
findings.why: The source describes constructing one output string with comma separators. 用逗號連線欄位 selects the connection sense rather than string concatenation. The neighboring emitted CSV-like string makes the required sense explicit; this is not a request to rename graphical connection lines elsewhere.
findings.cause: OpenCC maps 连接 to 連線 without accounting for the string-joining context.

evidence.suggestedTw: 再用逗號串接欄位。

findings.sourceWordingAlternative: Use 再用逗号分隔并拼接字段 in this SC desc.
regressionChecks: Preserve emitRow, the quoted output strings and the limited-character/not-complete-CSV qualifications.
Do not change 連線 in network or actual diagram-line contexts.

findings.title: The copy noun is misspelled as 覆制 in a visible title
findings.why: 覆制 is not the intended copy operation. The project explicitly normalizes copy to 複製, and the other reader strings about these copies already use 複製. This is a segmentation-induced wrong character, not a terminology preference.
findings.cause: OpenCC emits 說明覆制與引用. Existing 復制/複制 corrections do not cover 覆制.

findings.title: 并 is resolved to the wrong character in two explicit contexts
findings.why: The first clause coordinates satisfying a postcondition and succeeding; 併 incorrectly introduces the merge character. The other two labels explicitly prohibit merging messages, but spell that verb 合並 instead of 合併. Negation is not lost, and these are lower-priority orthographic defects rather than a claim that the diagrams reverse their outcomes.
findings.cause: Both forms are reproduced directly by OpenCC 1.4.1 on the full source phrases.

structuredComparisons.asciiTokenDefinition: Ordered maximal runs matching [\x21-\x7E]+, compared before and after conversion; includes Latin identifiers, numeric literals and ASCII code punctuation.
structuredComparisons.geometryClaimBoundary: Equal parsed SVG element trees and attributes establish that the conversion did not alter stored geometry or identifiers. They do not establish legibility, absence of rendered overlap, explanatory accuracy or screenshot approval.
structuredComparisons.metadataIdentifierBoundary: SC and TW fields coexist in one metadata object. IDs, anchors and code fields were not rewritten by this review; raw file hashes bind the snapshot. No unavailable pre-generation metadata baseline is claimed.

reportValidation.limitations: Proposal simulation used only the current reader text corpus, without writing or regenerating assets. It is not a full-book rule regression check or a rendered-layout check.

nonFindingsAndBoundaries: The existing ch19 pass/through repair is verified on this snapshot, not re-reported.

All 44 noteTw pairs retain their source qualifications, including placeholder behavior, trusted pickle data, non-equivalence to Java/C++, omitted implementations and lack of runtime guarantees. This is translation fidelity only, not an audit of the examples.
No preference-only findings for established choices such as 型別, 對映, 參數, 缺陷, 程式碼, 區域性, 字首/字尾, 回撥 or other comprehensible existing regional vocabulary.
The inherited SC wording, SC concept accuracy, code behavior and old full-book TW translation were not re-reviewed.
English/code tokens, formula values and SVG attributes matched in all extracted pairs. Metadata IDs and geometry must remain untouched when the main process applies any wording corrections.

Global postprocessing rules also affect content outside this review. Proposed late phrase corrections minimize scope but still require the main process to inspect the full regeneration diff and run its integration checks.
Hashes identify the exact reviewed files. A later regeneration or source edit requires a new check; this verdict must not be transferred to unreviewed bytes.

terminologyReferences.title: Programming With Assertions: Internal Invariants and Class Invariants
terminologyReferences.use: Primary definition of invariants as conditions/predicates over program state. Used only to disambiguate R3, not to prescribe a universal Chinese glossary or validate Buffer behavior.

terminologyReferences.title: String concatenation (Visual C#)
terminologyReferences.use: Uses 串連/串接 for string concatenation and describes joining strings with separators. Supports the term distinction in R9, not the completeness of the CSV-like example.

snapshotIdentity.sourceFileComposition: 100 SC SVGs + 32 JSON files containing both source and generated fields + 5 converter/config/test inputs.
snapshotIdentity.setDigestEncoding: Sort repository-relative ASCII paths in ordinal order. Concatenate each file's lowercase SHA-256, two ASCII spaces, its path, and LF; SHA-256 the UTF-8 result. Generated set contains the 100 paired *-tw.svg files. All-artifact set additionally contains every sourceFileHashes entry. The report itself is excluded.
